name: Color-Scheme-Generator
description: A responsive color scheme generator built with Vanilla JavaScript, CSS Grid, and The Color API. Features multiple harmony modes and one-click HEX clipboard copying.

paragraphs: A sleek, responsive, and interactive web application that generates harmonious 5-color palettes based on a selected seed color and color harmony scheme. Built with modern JavaScript, CSS Grid, and The Color API, featuring dynamic DOM rendering and one-click clipboard copying.
features: 🎯 Interactive Color Picker: Choose any base color using the native HTML5 .
🔄 Multiple Color Harmony Modes: Select from 6 mathematical harmony algorithms:
🌐 REST API Integration: Asynchronously queries The Color API using parameterized query strings (hex, mode, count).
📊 Dynamic CSS Grid Swatches: Automatically renders a 5-column color palette with reactive height and uppercase HEX codes.
📋 One-Click Copy to Clipboard: Click any color column to copy its HEX value straight to the clipboard via the asynchronous navigator.clipboard API.
